scope: Current redesign, local and hosted automated evidence; not manual conformance certification.

notes: Three DealPath scenarios passed with zero axe violations and zero uncaught errors: hire-first, client-first and 320px printed terms.

The 19 passing browser tests cover keyboard chapter navigation, Space/Enter presentation switching, persisted reading preference, skip link, system reduced motion, keyboard focus entering normal reading and notes-to-browser-back restoration of the tour.
Both routes pass axe scans with WCAG 2 A/AA, 2.1 AA and 2.2 AA tags in ordinary reading mode. Automated scans are not a complete conformance assessment.
The complete flyer and linked proposal notes remain readable without JavaScript; no canvas fallback is needed.
Ordinary reading and notes have no horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 768 and 1440px. Camera targets fit at 320, 390 and 1440px in automated framing checks.

Final desktop/mobile review includes 320px typography. Automated framing checks assert at least 12px rendered body text; the cash-flow body measures 12.2px at 320 and 14.9px at 390. Physical-device readability is still unverified.
VoiceOver review was not performed. Semantic HTML, axe and keyboard checks are not screen-reader-equivalent manual proof.
A browser-emulated touch gesture is tested; physical iOS/Android devices and notched-screen behavior are unverified.
Viewport reflow is tested. Manual text resizing, browser zoom and forced-colors coverage are not claimed.
